gaps.sentence: I came ___ an old letter while clearing the attic.
I bumped ___ my neighbour at the dentist's.
gaps.explanation: bump into somebody = meet by chance.

gaps.sentence: The store decided to branch ___ into online sales.
gaps.explanation: branch out = start doing something new and different.

gaps.sentence: The factory laid ___ two hundred workers.
gaps.explanation: lay off = dismiss workers because there is not enough work.

gaps.sentence: The match was called ___ because of the storm.
Their son grew ___ and moved abroad.
They've set ___ a new charity for homeless dogs.
It took him weeks to get ___ the flu.
gaps.explanation: get over an illness/upset = recover from it.
